# forge-example-gasless-membership

> Composed gasless membership club: ERC-721 pass with an approver allowlist (MembershipNFT) and an ERC-4337 paymaster that sponsors exactly the join() UserOperation (ClubPaymaster, extends eth-infinitism BasePaymaster v0.9.0), plus a viem front end.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [src/MembershipNFT.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/blob/main/src/MembershipNFT.sol): contract
- [src/ClubPaymaster.sol](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/blob/main/src/ClubPaymaster.sol): contract
- [component-map.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/blob/main/component-map.json): provenance
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/Blockchains/forge-example-gasless-membership/blob/main/NOTICE): attribution
